name_zh: 桑地诺/尼加拉瓜/游击/反美/海军/英雄/奥古斯托/拉斯/塞戈维亚
core_mode: M607 游击反美/海军英雄/桑地诺主义/拉斯塞戈维亚/反帝符号
description_zh: 奥古斯托·桑地诺（1934-1990），尼加拉瓜前总统，1979-1990年在位。他是一位尼加拉瓜政治家，前海军军官，通过领导尼加拉瓜革命推翻了萨尔瓦多·索摩莎的独裁统治。桑地诺是游击战争的领导者，领导了尼加拉瓜革命，推翻了美国支持的索摩扎政权。他在领导革命中，提出了"拉斯塞戈维亚"的游击战理论，体现了反帝英雄主义精神。他的统治时期，尼加拉瓜实现了从独裁到革命的过渡，但也面临了美国的持续干预。
description_en: Augusto Sandino (1934-1990), former President of Nicaragua, served from 1979 to 1990. He was a Nicaraguan politician and former naval officer, led the Nicaraguan Revolution to overthrow Somoza's dictatorship. Sandino was the leader of the guerrilla war, led the Nicaraguan Revolution to overthrow the US-backed Somoza regime. He proposed "Las Segovias" guerrilla warfare theory in leading the revolution, exemplified anti-imperial heroism. His rule period, Nicaragua achieved transition from dictatorship to revolution, but also faced continuous US intervention.
